claims.statement: The locked-account unlinking guide is FPT/GHEC only and applies after lost 2FA credentials and inability to recover access. Unlinking does not disable 2FA or restore access; if access cannot be regained it permanently breaks account/email linkage.
The source requires ensuring all access is lost before proceeding and links the separate 2FA recovery guide. Email reuse is not recovery of the original repositories, permissions or profile.

The password path prompts 2FA with username/password or linked social login, selects recovery-code options, begins account/email recovery and acknowledges the modal. Email one-time verification may be required.
The password-path OTP goes to primary/backup addresses; absent a specifically chosen backup, all verified emails count as backup. A configured backup alone does not enumerate all actual recipients.

The no-password path requests a reset using primary/backup addresses, with all verified addresses backup unless specifically chosen. Reset links require activation within three hours, distinct from 24-hour ordinary verification links; spam checking does not establish receipt.
The no-password flow then reaches 2FA account/email recovery and acknowledgement. A password-reset link cannot establish bypass of 2FA or restored account access.

The common unlinking flow starts/continues unlinking, sends links to every account email, and requires the desired mailbox's Unlink this email link plus final Unlink confirmation. Sending links does not prove every address unlinked.

Creating a new account or adding the unlinked address to an existing account is optional and separate. Paid subscriptions, sponsor payments or received sponsorships may require support cancellation/migration; unlinking does not automatically end billing.
No passwords, OTPs, reset links, mailbox contents or personal records are collected or committed. No unlinking, recovery, account creation, support message or billing change is performed.
